text:
maya: Tiny plan 1) snack swap on the island 2) two-word kudos 3) optional micro-haiku (3-4-3). Drop what you're swapping + two words for a coworker + haiku if you want. Ill start: "jar strawberry jam (fridge)" + "steady calm" for @marta. haiku: "jam on toast / mornings get brighter / small victory"

marta: Love it. Swapping a can of good black tea. Two-word for @jon: "debug wizard". haiku: "steam in mug / bug becomes a tale / fixed"

jon: Ill trade a packet of spicy peanuts. Two-word for @lenora: "ship captain". GIF: <https://gifs.internal/thumbs-up.gif>

sam: In. Banana bread slices on the top shelf. Two-word for @maya: "spark starter" :banana:

lenora: Taking the peanuts, thanks. Two-word for the squad: "quiet powerhouse". Quick poll: sour candy? react +1 for yes, -1 for no

ava: +1 for sour. Two-word for @sam: "oven hero" :chef:

ops-bot: ops-bot: Friendly kitchen reminder: label all food with name + date. Unlabelled items will be donated after 72h. Kitchen guide: https://redwood-internal/handbook/kitchen :label:

marta: Also shoutout to @ops-team for restocking napkins yesterday 1 two-word: "paper champions"

maya: Sticker idea: colored dot = available, silver = claimed. Ill print some at 16:10. haiku from me: "crumbs on shelf / tiny trades of kindness / coffee hums"

jon: Nominating @marta for the next snack raffle. Two-word for @ava: "popcorn queen" :popcorn:

lenora: Poll result (informal): sour candy wins by 3. Ill bring a bag tomorrow :candy:

sam: Logistics quick note: please put swaps in a labeled zip bag, write name + WED date. Cool?

marta: Done. See yall at the island :wave:
